text:
Maria K.: deploy-bot put a promo-hold on 2026-01-12 09:12 UTC — partial artifact upload detected for image index shard 'shard-42'.
deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion paused for release v2.18.3. Reason: multipart upload incomplete, shard checksum mismatch. Actions: pin candidate or retry upload. /details https://ci.internal/reports/1758904321
Ashok: ugh, saw this on staging too. Is it failing on the client-side or s3-side?
Maria K.: looks like multipart commit returned 200 but index metadata shows fewer objects for shard-42 in eu-west-1. other regions OK. logs attached:
Maria K.: ```
upload_part: part 5/12 -> 200
complete_multipart_upload -> 200
verify_index -> found 11/12 parts for shard-42
checksum expected: a1b2.. got: a1b2.. (mismatch length)
``` 
Liam: could be eventual consistency / delayed manifest replication. but checksum mismatch is not just missing part.
Ashok: can we re-run the upload job for that shard only? what's the deploy-bot retry policy?
deploy-bot: retry policy: 3 attempts spaced 30s, 5m, 15m. Manual reupload allowed by 'cictl reupload --shard shard-42 --release v2.18.3'
Maria K.: I kicked a reupload once, but it errored with EEXISTS on the multipart commit -> suggests concurrent commit from another runner.
SRE Oncall: I'm seeing increased 5xxs from the object-store gateway around that time window, could explain partial writes. Investigating.
Ashok: options: 1) pin release to last good image (v2.18.2) and unblock promos, 2) force reupload and wait for checks, 3) rollforward with rebuilt artifact (bump build number) which requires regen + sanity tests.
Liam: pinning is fastest but loses the change window. how sensitive is the deployment? PM asked for this feature in this release.
Maria K.: PM OK with short delay if it's risky. but we prefer not to ship partial artifact.
SRE Oncall: recommendation: don't pin yet. Let me finish tracing gateway error, if it's transient we can reupload safely. If gateway rejects commit, we should rebuild.
Ashok: agree with SRE Oncall. I'll attempt a targeted reupload with 'cictl' and set a constrained lock to avoid concurrent commits. If it fails, we revert to rebuild+rollforward.
Maria K.: command I'll run: ```cictl reupload --shard shard-42 --release v2.18.3 --lock=exclusive --timeout=10m``` will report back here.
deploy-bot: note: any manual reupload overrides automated retry counters and will create new artifact digest. Be aware of downstream immutability checks.
Liam: if reupload succeeds, we still need a quick smoke e2e in staging (~10m). Can we parallelize smoke with canary rollout? prefer to run smoke first.
Maria K.: running reupload now.
Maria K.: reupload output: ```started reupload shard-42
part upload ok
complete_multipart_upload -> 200
verify_index -> 12/12 parts
checksum ok
artifact digest: sha256:deadbeef
``` 
SRE Oncall: gateway logs: transient 502s at 09:11:47, recovered by 09:12:05. looks resolved.
Ashok: great. Maria, can you trigger the staging smoke? Liam, please hold canary until smoke passes.
Maria K.: staging smoke started: job 1758904500
Maria K.: smoke passed (all green) in 6m.
Liam: canary hold lifted. I'll kick canary rollout and monitor.
deploy-bot: promotion resumed for v2.18.3, canary rollout started.
Maria K.: decision notes: attempted targeted reupload with exclusive lock -> succeeded; verified index and checksum; smoke passed; canary rolled. No pin needed.
Ashok: filing follow-up todo: add more robust commit-ack validation in the upload runner and a deterministic backoff to avoid concurrent commits. I'll open a ticket.
Maria K.: thanks team :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: closing investigation, will follow up if it reoccurs.
